channel.title: Noaman Khalil
channel.description: Notes on Bondi, Wiggle, Jabble, and the work around them.

item.title: Wiggle is in early access
item.description: Wiggle is an early-access Mac assistant. Shake the mouse and it appears at the cursor so you can chat, screenshot, ask out loud, or replay clicks and typing.

item.title: Going solo, in public
item.description: After product roles at Tesla, TOPPAN Security, Bayut and Dubizzle, I am building my own Mac apps under Jabble and writing about it here.

item.title: I got tired of paying for QR codes
item.description: Jabble.io is the marketing toolkit I built for myself: QR code menus, file transfer, short links, bio pages, and campaign analytics. Most of the useful parts are free.

item.title: Introducing Bondi
item.description: Bondi is a native Mac system monitor in alpha. It groups processes into apps and writes one checked sentence about why the Mac is slow. Launch is February 2, 2027.

item.title: Nomad, on the Mac
item.description: Project N.O.M.A.D is an offline survival computer. It did not have a native Mac version, so I made one. The repo has been public since March 17, 2026.

item.title: The keyboard I open sourced
item.description: Keyboard-pico is a keyboard I built and open sourced. The repository has been public since February 20, 2026.
